sourceState: Commit plus producer fixes, pinned by hashes
randomization: Fisher-Yates across 18 pairs; OS-random seed, LCG; launch order=schedule

tasks.title: Filtros de consulta de historial
tasks.requirement: Extend query(repo, options) with headsOnly=false, includeDemo=true, validity='' (one VALIDITY value or empty). headsOnly returns only unique current ref heads; includeDemo=false excludes demo experiences; validity filters by exact value. Preserve all existing filters and defaults, preserve repository. Invalid validity must throw.

tasks.title: Presupuesto de contexto reproducible
tasks.requirement: Extend contextPacket options with maxLessons. Omission preserves current behavior and ordering. Supplied maxLessons must be an integer in 1..1000, otherwise throw. When supplied, sort eligible lessons by commitId, subject, predicate, claim using string lexical comparisons, then return the first maxLessons. Preserve scope filtering and no mutation.

tasks.title: Hipótesis excluidas del contexto operativo
tasks.requirement: contextPacket must exclude lessons with type=hypothesis by default. Add includeHypotheses=false option; true admits hypotheses under all other existing filters. Never admit intuition/disputed, demo or non-active experiences. Preserve includeNegative behavior and exact lesson scope.

tasks.title: Filtros del registro externo
tasks.requirement: GET /api/experiences accepts optional domain (exact string) and outcome (one of success/failure/partial/incomplete). Filter returned items by payload.domain and payload.outcome.status, combining both with AND, when payload came from DB as JSON string. Empty omitted filters preserve behavior; invalid nonempty outcome returns 400. No writes or quota consumption on GET. Operate on existing up-to-50 retrieved records; no pagination claim.

tasks.title: Comprobaciones HTTP sin cuerpos
tasks.requirement: Support HEAD for embedded static assets (including /), /.well-known/dxp.json, and /api/evaluation. Match GET status and headers but return no body; never write DB or consume intake quota. Unknown HEAD path must match GET 404 with empty body. Existing POST ingestion must still work.

tasks.title: Informes con control de nota equivalente
tasks.requirement: POST /api/experiments optionally accepts noteSuccess. If present, require integer 0..sampleSize, recompute computedDifferenceVsNote=(dxpSuccess-noteSuccess)/sampleSize ignoring submitted derived value, preserve scientificallyVerified=false. Legacy two-arm reports without noteSuccess remain accepted and must omit computedDifferenceVsNote even if client spoofs it. Reject null, strings, negative, noninteger and out-of-range noteSuccess with 400 before storing.

model: Same inherited parent model, no overrides; backend revision not exposed.
tools: Same local exec_command/apply_patch policy for all
primaryMetric: All preregistered task and regression assertions pass in coordinator evaluation, immutable tests unchanged, only authorized source edits
secondaryMetrics: elapsed wall time from spawn to response; includes tool delays
tool calls self-reported, exact count not independently observable
informationParity: Note contains every field of frozen DXP commit, all evidence/actions/limits/IDs. DXP adds real validator/query/context interface, no extra lesson or solution.
heldOut: Producer fixed launcher and route identity; no tested feature solution in memory.
integration: Score all before integration. Select passing patches, combine, then re-run all six task suites and full production regressions.

isolation.files: separate identical module checkout; no .git, diary, research, previous consumer output or live site data
isolation.enforcement: Procedural directory boundary, NOT per-agent OS sandbox. Host shared, other paths technically readable. Full access audit and sealed isolation unavailable; report this limitation.
isolation.sourceScope: Production core/worker source with isolated build harness, synthetic unit-only assets and DB double; no live deployment access

interpretation: 6 paired tasks, one run per condition/task; no general validity/statistical significance/cross-model claims.
Tests access/representation, not separate causal contribution of versioning.
Protocol violation or missing isolation/metrics must be disclosed, never simulated as completed.
